tools.name: find_labs
tools.description: Nearest Hera partner labs near a US ZIP code for a semen analysis, a post-vasectomy check, a semen culture, a sperm DNA fragmentation test or sperm freezing (cryopreservation), with the price, where it is paid, and a link to order online. Use for "where can I get a sperm test near me" questions.

tools.name: get_lab
tools.description: Address, phone, hours, walk-in policy, at-home collection, visit instructions and prices for one Hera partner lab. Pass the labRef returned by find_labs.

tools.name: hera_facts
tools.description: Hera Fertility facts in its own words: what Hera is, how ordering works, price, turnaround, results, at-home collection, semen cultures, post-vasectomy checks, DNA fragmentation, sperm freezing, hormone panels, retests, insurance, refunds and changes, medical questions, privacy.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_labs · Public sink: find_labs, hera_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_labs · Public sink: find_labs, hera_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_lab" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Address, phone, hours, walk-in policy, at-home collection, visit instructions and prices for one Hera partner lab. labId comes from find_labs." → after: "Address, phone, hours, walk-in policy, at-home collection, visit instructions and prices for one Hera partner lab. Pass the labRef returned by find_labs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
